description: This file defines the ProductService interface, which specifies methods related to product management within the sales manager system. It includes methods for adding descriptions, retrieving products based on locale, categories, store, and tax class, as well as for saving or updating products.

classes.name: ProductService
classes.description: Interface for product-related business operations within the sales manager system.

methods.name: addProductDescription
methods.description: Associates a product description with a specific product, potentially updating existing descriptions.

methods.name: getProductDescription
methods.description: Retrieves the description of a product for a specified language.

methods.name: getProductForLocale
methods.description: Fetches a product for a specific locale, considering language and regional settings.

methods.name: getProductsForLocale
methods.description: Retrieves a list of products within a category for a specific locale.

methods.name: getProducts
methods.description: Retrieves products based on a list of category IDs.

methods.name: listByStore
methods.description: Lists products available in a specific store, optionally filtered by criteria.

methods.name: listByTaxClass
methods.description: Lists products associated with a specific tax class.

methods.name: getBySeUrl
methods.description: Retrieves a product based on a store, SEO URL, and locale.

methods.name: getByCode
methods.description: Fetches a product by its SKU (code) for a particular language.
